program: testdata/rhtest/cpp-clang.exe
function: measure at 0x401110
step: promote
vector: 1
difference: call 2: ra_trap is called where the record calls ra_call

The machine level replays equal; `promote` is the first step that differs. Bisect writes no
case ahead of `promote`, since a case cannot load the machine state, so this note stands for
the case until the promotion of `measure` is fixed or a case can carry the state.
